    angular_velocity_gain = 2.5  # Reduced for smoother response
    position_gain = 2.0    # Reduced to avoid overshoot
    velocity_gain = 1.0    # Reduced for better damping

    force = -angle_gain * theta - angular_velocity_gain * omega - position_gain * (x - target_x) - velocity_gain * v

    # Safety margin: reduce force when near track edge and apply proactive braking
    distance = abs(x - target_x)
    if distance > (safe_half_range - 0.05) and distance < safe_half_range:
        # Reduce force to prevent overshoot and apply braking
